t: Specialist heavy duty steel-reinforced fixing for dot and dab walls. Steel core bridges cavity between plasterboard and masonry, transferring load directly to blockwork and avoiding plasterboard crushing. Offers 55kg safe working load per single fixing (safety factor 2). Easy to install using just a drill, screwdriver and hammer. Suitable for all brick and block types, including lightweight blockwork, with maximum 10mm bracket / fixture thickness. Maximum distance of 45mm from outer face of wall to blockwork behind. Ideal for brackets, shelves and heavy items. Quick and easy installation.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Brickwork, Stone, Blockwork & Plasterboard
